answer: Sampling audit per epoch: 8 percent of submissions, judged by three auditors who share no operator. Renting 1,000 identities means 80 audited answers per epoch, and each audit is a chance to lose the whole batch. At 12 minutes of model time per answer, that is 16 extra hours a week. Your garden grows only as fast as audited answers survive. The ocean of cheap clones still has to cross the same falcon-eyed panel.
